SELECT
  MAX(subq_10.order_count) AS order_count
  , MAX(subq_17.first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_17.first_order_sales_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_24.new_member_count) AS new_member_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2024-09-30'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT case when is_first_order then member_id end) AS first_buyer_count
    , SUM(case when is_first_order then net_cents else 0 end) AS first_order_sales_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."order_validity" order_validity_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2024-09-30'
) subq_17
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS new_member_count
  FROM "data"."main"."members" members_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', registered_at) BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2024-09-30'
) subq_24

2024年9月（2024-09-01至2024-09-30，全部成交门店合并、未按门店或地区分组）青禾的统计结果如下：
- 创建订单数：1 单（按下单日期统计全部订单，每个订单号计一次，含取消单）
- 观测期首购会员数：1 个 CRM 会员账户（指在测试覆盖期内首次有效订单落在9月的账户数，非终身首购概念，也不等同于自然人数）
- 观测期首单净销售额：10.00 元（该账户在覆盖期内第一笔有效订单的净销售额，按订单日期归属9月）
- 注册会员数：8 个 CRM 会员账户（按9月注册日期统计的新账户数，不代表自然人数）
以上均在青禾客户数据范围内统计，统计单位为 CRM 会员账户；本月未应用任何门店筛选条件。
